title: What If You Lived in Space for a Year? NASA Tested Twins

scenes.text: What if you lived in space for a year? NASA tested it with identical twins.
Scott Kelly spent 340 days on the space station. His twin Mark stayed on Earth.
The surprise: Scott's telomeres, the caps on DNA, grew about fourteen percent longer in space.
Within days of landing, they shrank back, and months later some were shorter than before.
His memory and logic scores dropped after landing, and his gut bacteria changed.
Most changes reversed. But nine percent of the genes stayed in space mode after he returned.

description:
What if you lived in space for a year?
NASA's Twins Study found longer telomeres in flight, then changes in memory tests and some genes that stayed altered after return.
